title: Add historical simulator with explicit point-in-time data limits
body:
Adds an offline event-time simulator for exact archived Alpha OS v1, Risk Engine v2 and Buy & Hold replay, plus a separately named price/VIX-only overlay research mode. This PR is stacked on #1 (base fix/risk-engine-v2) to keep simulator changes separate; neither PR is merged.

Decisions see only bars and observations published by decision time; trades fill at later opens. Includes commissions, adverse slippage, configurable session delays, repeated-TRIM handling, restoration after consecutive actionable HOLDs, cash/share accounting, drawdown, false-signal censoring and FIFO missed-recovery diagnostics. The legacy v1 source is preserved exactly from main a14ebf9 and checked by a blob-hash test. Missing archives never produce approximated full-strategy metrics.

Actual inputs: 10,053 completed daily stock bars across AMD, NVDA, MU, TSM, AVGO, AMAT, AMZN, META, PLTR, LRCX and NBIS, and 983 daily CBOE VIX observations. Source URLs, retrieval timestamp, SHA-256 hashes and normalized artifacts are committed. Last completed session: 2026-10-22; 2026-10-23 was incomplete at retrieval and excluded. NBIS starts 2024-10-21, not January 2024.

Results: 44 full v1/v2 symbol/window comparisons are UNAVAILABLE because no point-in-time fundamental/revision/derived-input archives exist. Separately, 44 explicitly limited price replays and all 297 predeclared sensitivity variants are exported. For September 1–October 22, baseline overlay produced 403 HOLD, 4 REVIEW, no TRIM; returns equal Buy & Hold for all 11 symbols. Extended replays show foregone recovery and lower returns after tactical reductions. No threshold winner is selected or claimed effective.

Validation: 56 tests passed, 20 subtests passed; no failing/skipped tests. Compilation, staged diff checks, input/source checksums and output counts passed. Strict audit rejects all public-data comparisons as expected. Tests cover future-information gating, future mutations, delayed execution, costs, restoration, repeated reductions, missing data, exact v1/v2 synthetic archive replay and checksum failures.

Read reports/risk-backtest-v1/report.md, summary.csv, signals.csv, trades.csv, equity.csv, sensitivity.csv and validation.md. Reproduction/data contract: docs/risk-backtest-v1.md.

Limitations: downloaded price vintages and inferred publication times are NOT verified point-in-time data. Provider OHLC can be retrospectively split-adjusted; no dividend/corporate-action cash-flow ledger or exchange calendar is implemented. Research returns are provider-price path returns, not total returns. Full comparison requires verified publication/vintage archives, corporate-action handling, original fundamentals/revisions/scores and regime/thesis inputs, and an independently reserved validation period. No production services, PostgreSQL, Railway or main branch were changed; no merges/deployments performed.
head: feature/risk-backtest-v1
